key_insight: A deep truncated FBSDE solver stabilizes high-dimensional nonlinear PDE learning by decoupling strongly coupled forward-backward dynamics with gradient truncation, fictitious-play averaging, and pathwise consistency shortcuts.
engineering_relevance: This offers a more robust numerical tool for convection-dominated and strongly coupled PDEs that are difficult for standard deep-learning FBSDE solvers to train reliably.
method: Gradient-truncated iterative decoupling to reduce unstable feedback from parameter-dependent forward paths
Fictitious-play averaging to preserve coupled dynamics while improving optimization stability
Pathwise consistency loss to provide explicit local gradient shortcuts and help mitigate vanishing gradients
evidence_signal: The abstract reports improved accuracy and stability in low- and high-dimensional tests, with strong performance on fully coupled and convection-dominated problems.
watch_item: The method’s convergence guarantees are conditional, and the pathwise consistency loss is not required in the fully discrete theory, so practical performance may depend on tuning and problem structure.
paper_title: Deep Truncated FBSDE Method: A Robust Solver for High-Dimensional Nonlinear PDEs and Fully Coupled FBSDEs
